source: GridGuard gb-corridor-xgb-v1: calibrated XGBoost hourly outage risk in each line's 5 km corridor, trained on SSEN NaFIRS weather-caused overhead-line faults with ERA5 (Open-Meteo) route weather. Area-level proxy, not a verified transmission-line failure probability.
name: Storm Darragh (ERA5 replay)
